command: scripts/lib/capture-opencode-session.sh — a private `opencode serve` with the plugin, `run --auto` on CAPTURE_PROMPT (OC_MODEL=deepseek/deepseek-flash), then `session delete` through that server
prompt: Use the subagent tool to have a subagent read NOTE.txt and report its content, then tell me what it said.
note: The `subagent` tool's child is its own session, created with the parent's `parentID`; deleting the parent deletes the child first.
